title: How to Embed the Newsletter Form to a Static Page
text:
## How to Embed the Newsletter Form to a Static Page
Link: https://support.brilliantdirectories.com/support/solutions/articles/12000076734
This article explains how to add the newsletter signup form to a static web page using the Brilliant Directories Web Page Builder.
There are three common ways to display the newsletter signup form on a static page:
Add the default newsletter widget to a sidebar
Embed the newsletter form directly on the page using the form shortcode
Add a button that opens the newsletter signup form in a modal popup

## Option 1: Add the Newsletter Widget to a Sidebar
This option displays the newsletter signup widget inside a sidebar assigned to a static page.
Important: Sidebars can be added to static pages, except for the homepage URL /home .

## Step 1: Create a New Sidebar
Go to Toolbox >> Sidebar Manager .
Click New Sidebar .
Enter a sidebar nickname.
Click Save Sidebar .
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12181299370/original/YO8ShJxAQKApqIj3HPl1CTO1PDiqeNmFzw.gif?1782866930 | alt: ]

## Step 2: Add the Newsletter Widget to the Sidebar
Find the new sidebar in the Sidebar Manager.
Click Edit .
Drag and drop the following widget into the sidebar:
Bootstrap Theme - Module - Newsletter Sign Up Form
Click Save Changes .
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12181299491/original/l5OmWu6Q3rLuYTK6oMhW9_2_7n7zPZkC9A.gif?1782867122 | alt: ]

## Step 3: Assign the Sidebar to a Static Page
Go to Content >> Web Page Builder .
Create a new web page or edit an existing static page.
Scroll to the page display settings.
Select the new sidebar under the page’s display options.
Click Save Changes .
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12181300262/original/Fcp8Lpi1ACLXJsnKhOUaLqMeixtme8QNAg.gif?1782869300 | alt: ]
The newsletter signup widget will now display in the sidebar area of the selected static page.
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12181300258/original/v6xlIxyEk1M_M7B8XRIf1XsMN37Pt7q3rg.png?1782869221 | alt: ]

## Option 2: Embed the Newsletter Form Directly on the Page
This option places the newsletter signup form directly inside the content area of the static page.

## Step 1: Copy the Newsletter Form Shortcode
Go to Toolbox >> Form Manager .
Find the form named Website - Newsletter Signup Form .
Under the Actions column, click Copy to Clipboard .
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12181301032/original/kSo3FbP1ap1DDoM3-ufu9PruuMqyAVbPxw.gif?1782871241 | alt: ]

## Step 2: Add the Shortcode to the Static Page
Go to Content >> Web Page Builder .
Create a new static page or edit an existing one.
Paste the copied form shortcode into the page content area where the form should appear.
Click Save Changes .
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12181301613/original/N7cjpcbOPBc4nY9Wjab0ICj_ibUuC0v25g.gif?1782872387 | alt: ]
The newsletter signup form will now display directly on the static page.
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12181301710/original/YXZzuSrgiITEm8hO6HeVnAq-dYsAQJQ5qA.png?1782872783 | alt: ]

## Option 3: Add a Button That Opens the Newsletter Modal
This option adds a button to the static page. When clicked, the button opens the newsletter signup form in a popup modal.

## Step 1: Add a Button to the Page
Go to Content >> Web Page Builder .
Create a new static page or edit an existing page.
Add a button using the draggable content blocks.
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12181301845/original/L8rZi7dM2O3uli_JML9RuhDlsIvTbU0BfA.gif?1782873513 | alt: ]
